audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Trouble, sanctuary, offerings, king, chariots, horses, and military trust.

verses.restored: The YHWH hear you in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend you;

familiar.text: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

verses.restored: Send you help from the sanctuary, and strengthen you out of Zion;

familiar.text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

verses.restored: Remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice; Selah.

familiar.text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

verses.restored: Grant you according to your own heart, and fulfil all your counsel.

familiar.text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.restored: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the YHWH fulfil all your petitions.

familiar.text: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.restored: Now know I that the YHWH saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

familiar.text: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.restored: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the YHWH our God.

familiar.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

verses.restored: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

familiar.text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.restored: Save, YHWH: let the king hear us when we call.

familiar.text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer. Curated overrides preserve major lexical or textual issues where identified.
safety_note: Royal military prayer is not an endorsement of nationalism or war; the psalm explicitly relativizes weapons and military power.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
